profile.headline: Building Social AI.
profile.summary:
[Not based in US] 
I am passionate about frontend development and adhere to good practices.

Throughout my career, I have consistently demonstrated strong problem-solving abilities, collaborated effectively within teams, and maintained a sociable demeanor. Currently, I hold the position of Staff Engineer at Canrina Labs., an esteemed company founded by Sean Parker and headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

My journey in coding began during my school years, where I discovered my affinity for software development. Recognizing the alignment between my interests and software engineering, I embarked on a path that has proven to be the perfect fit for me.

Since then, my dedication to continuous improvement has been unwavering. I take great pride in the growth I have achieved as a developer and the unwavering commitment I bring to each project.

My proficiency extends across a range of programming languages, including ReactJS, VueJs, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Styled-components. However, I am constantly expanding my skill set, always eager to learn new technologies and tools to enhance my repertoire.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer (Frontend)
positions.description:
Building Social AI.

Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Founded by Sean Parker, Daniel Klaus, and Prakash Ramakrishna, Aircore is infrastructure powering the world’s social transformation with real-time communication tools.

We offer real-time social (RTS) software to give users the immediate shared experiences they want, with fast and flexible APIs to power the next generation of collaboration. Our products help companies deliver real-time audio, video and social solutions to their users inside their own products. Our products help companies drive deeper connection, engagement and retention with their users.

Aircore brings together everything needed to add robust real-time social to apps and sites. We do the heavy lifting with our fully integrated suite of low-level APIs, builder-driven SDKs, and UI toolkits. Our modular solutions work all together or independently, to best fit your needs.
positions.insights: Skills: esbuild · vanilla-extract · Preact · Next.js · TypeScript · turborepo

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Founded by Sean Parker and backed by several major VC’s, Airtime is a new social platform for iOS, Android, and Web. It is a totally new social experience that brings you closer to your closest friends and family all day every day through messaging, media co-consumption, and video chat.

Developing a real time web application, using Vuejs and web sockets.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · Storybooks · esbuild · Webpack · JavaScript · React.js · Preact · WebSocket · JavaScript eXtension (JSX) · Next.js · TypeScript · turborepo · Vuex · styled-components
